name: Angel's halo
description: The dull gray halo Tazri took from the angel she killed, which glows and shelters her mind during Kozilek's field.

description_citations.work: The Blight We Were Born For
description_citations.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tazri kills the angel despite warnings of a curse and takes her halo, losing something unnamed in herself.
timeline.quote: She reached down to take the dull gray halo from the angel's eyes.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
timeline.quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.
